summary: Make refused mailbox binds visible in driver warnings and seat delivery state

replay.detail: Delivery presence remains daemon-local diagnostic state, not graph history or mailbox custody.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: Mailbox admission and ownership checks remain fail-closed. Refused channels retain their existing capped exponential retry.

compatibility.detail: AgentDelivery adds refused, a delivery refused: <code> reason, and nullable since_unix_ms. The st3 OTLP meter exports st.delivery.state_age (unit s) with st.agent, st.delivery.state=live|stale|refused and st.delivery.reason. Reason is empty for live/stale; refused uses only mailbox-runtime-indeterminate, stale-mailbox-session, mailbox-binding-conflict, mailbox-peer-mismatch, mailbox-not-authorized, recipient-retired or other. Every locally owned declared agent emits one series, including inactive, unknown and never-bound agents as stale. Membership reuses mailbox_metrics::managed_agents_owned_by_local_host, selecting kind=agent and member.host=store.origin(). One worker refreshes a complete cached summary off-scrape; collection does no store, graph, process or filesystem work. Repeated refusal does not reset state age. Alert on stale/refused age above 600 seconds.

manual.detail: Read driver-api-warnings.log for refusal codes; shared agent delivery data exposes the same code to CLI, web and TUI consumers.

recovery.detail: A successful bind clears refusal evidence. A new runtime incarnation does not inherit a predecessor's refusal. Daemon restart resets diagnostic state and its observed unhealthy duration.
